text:
Olivia (CSE): customer rotated SSO provisioned key this morning, their nightly batch embeddings started 403ing. generation endpoints still work. urgent, customer blocked.
Jules (Support): can you paste a repro (curl + job id) and the exact 403 body? also cust id so we can find audit logs.
Olivia (CSE): job id 98765, cust: acme-corp-prod. repro curl we used: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.infer/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sso_XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["foo"]}'
```
response: 
```json
{"error":"forbidden","message":"missing scope: embeddings","code":403}
```
Olivia (CSE): customer says they only rotated the SSO key via SCIM yesterday, no other config changes.
Sam (SRE): can you run token introspection (or paste the introspect output from our audit)? need to see how scopes are stored.
Olivia (CSE): pasted audit snippet from auth-introspect: 
```json
{"token":"sso_XXX","active":true,"client_id":"acme-sso","scopes":"generation;rerank;embeddings","issued_at":1750998000}
```
Sam (SRE): hmmm scopes show up but separated by semicolons. our enforcement split logic only splits on commas. that would yield one big scope string and we won't match "embeddings".
Priya (Infra): confirmed — SCIM sync we shipped last week started writing scopes using semicolons when there are multiple values. regression: auth introspect parser still doing scopes.split(','). quick fix: change split to scopes.split(/[,;\s]+/) and add a unit test for SCIM payloads.
AuthBot: Incident created INC-2025-042: auth: scoping parse regression from SCIM sync (assigned to Priya).
Sam (SRE): short-term workaround: create an explicit API key via Console with embeddings scope and give to customer (or instruct them to re-provision via our Console). but they said SSO-only policy.
Jules (Support): I'll open an expedited escalation to their account team and notify AE. can we ETA the patch + canary?
Priya (Infra): I can patch and roll a canary to staging in ~20m, prod canary within 2h assuming tests pass. will add hotfix to parsing and a migration script to normalize stored scope strings.
Olivia (CSE): customer requires statement for audit. I'll prepare a short blurb explaining root cause (SCIM wrote semicolon-separated scopes; enforcement only split on commas) and the mitigation plan.
Sam (SRE): after patch we should run a reconcile to detect other tokens with semicolons and normalize them. also add e2e test to nightly that simulates SSO rotation.
Jules (Support): noted, I'll DM the AE and attach the temporary workaround and the apology. marking high priority. :exclamation:
Priya (Infra): assigning self, ping me here if the customer needs a signed note. I'll post deploy status.
Olivia (CSE): thanks all — please update thread when canary is up so I can tell the customer.
Jules (Support): added follow-up tasks in the case: CASE-4521.
Priya (Infra): canary up in staging (1751000026). will push to prod in 1h if green.
Sam (SRE): after prod deploy, run the reconcile and I'll run an integration job against a sample customer to confirm embeddings success.
Olivia (CSE): confirmed with customer after prod fix: batch embeddings resumed. they accepted temporary documentation for their auditors. closing loop once migration completes. :white_check_mark:
